chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The interceder is the wing of the seeker.
ai.seo_question: What is the role of intercession in Shia theology according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) describes the intercessor as the 'wing of the seeker,' a metaphor rooted in Shia theology that highlights intercession (shafa'ah) not as an independent power but as a divine facilitation granted to the faithful. This concept underscores the necessity of spiritual support in the journey toward salvation, reflecting the belief that while God is the ultimate source, the prophets and imams serve as the means through which believers ascend to divine proximity. The imagery evokes the idea that just as a wing is essential for flight, the intercessor provides the essential grace required for the seeker to overcome spiritual limitations.
